extra.prompt:
https://jdjira.justdial.com/browse/GJDT-22686

Answers from the tester:
- Q: Environment? A: Ask For Price is on devx only (not live yet). For Ask For Price cases open ${devx} first (HTTP auth), then the devx search URL; carousel-order cases run on www.justdial.com live URLs. Platform: touch / mobile site.
- Q: Does Ask For Price need mobile/OTP? A: Yes. Mobile is ${test_mobile} (9324751210). OTP: api get "http://192.168.131.12/communication/api/v1/get_events?mobileEmail=${test_mobile}&vertical=OTP" as otpResp, then store json otpResp path data.response.0.sms.text as otpText, then store regex "(\d{4,8})" from otpText as otp.
- Q: How to verify lead generation? A: After submitting Ask For Price, call http://192.168.35.197:8111/lead_gen.php?city=${city}&date=${today}&mobile=${test_mobile}&msg=1&dev=1 where city = the searched city from the page URL (lowercase), today = current date as YYYY-MM-DD (get today as d, format date "${d}" as "YYYY-MM-DD" into today), dev=1 for devx/staging and dev=0 for www live. The response must contain the mobile, the searched category and: page name rsltpge, position recommended-products, lead type get_best_price, bd 1.
- Q: Click tracking? A: Use start capturing network requests before clicking. On Ask For Price click, a request containing li=gbp_afp_b2b_plisting_carousel must be sent. A request containing submit__gbp_afp_b2b_plisting_carousel must NOT be sent before the lead is submitted and MUST be sent after successful lead generation.
- Q: Ordering among outside cities (GJDT-22703)? A: Not specified — do not assert a specific order among outside cities, only the DS > search-city > price hierarchy.
assumptions: Ask For Price is devx-only; all Ask For Price / click-tracking / lead-gen testcases were pointed at ${devx} + a devx search URL, while pure carousel-ordering testcases (unchanged, kept) remain on live URLs per the tester's environment split.
Assumed ${url_steel_merchants} exposes the Ask For Price CTA on its recommended-products carousel on devx; if not, the URL needs to be swapped per the open question.

Reused the otp_fields / otp_1st_field / gbp_sheet_heading / gbp_submit_now_button elements (already recorded for the Send Enquiry/GBP flow) for the Ask For Price OTP screen, assuming the same OTP widget is shared.

Assumed the framework's `store network request containing "<text>" as <var>` returns an empty/non-matching value when no such request was sent, allowing a negative check via `verify stored <var> is not "<text>"` since no dedicated negative network-assertion step exists in the grammar.
Assumed the lead_gen.php 'bd' check is satisfied by the literal substring "bd" appearing in the response; exact key/value format (e.g. "bd":1) was not verified against a real response sample.
The magic name expected value (wap2_rfq_askforprice_rsltpge) was written literally in the assertion since it is a fixed spec value from GJDT-22688, not environment- or run-specific data.
unclear: Whether the lead_gen.php city parameter needs explicit lowercasing via a framework step not present in the given step vocabulary.
